# Veintiuno

> Veintiuno is an educational blackjack app for iPhone and Mac (App Store: "Blackjack Trainer: Veintiuno") and a free website that teaches blackjack basic strategy honestly: no real money, no casino affiliate links, no promises of winning. All charts and figures are computed with the same deterministic expected-value engine the app uses (6 decks unless stated; visible cards removed), validated against multi-million-hand simulations.

Key facts used across the site:
- With perfect basic strategy the house edge is about 0.36% (6 decks, dealer stands on soft 17, double after split, late surrender, peek) and about 0.63% with typical Spanish casino rules (no hole card, double on 9–11 only, no surrender).
- A 6:5 blackjack payout adds about 1.39 points to the house edge; dealer hitting soft 17 adds about 0.22.
- Dealer bust probability (6 decks, S17, after checking for blackjack): 2: 35.4%, 3: 37.4%, 4: 39.6%, 5: 41.8%, 6: 42.3%, 7: 26.2%, 8: 24.4%, 9: 22.9%, 10: 23.0%, ace: 16.6%.
- 16 vs 10 (10-6, 6 decks, S17): stand −0.542, hit −0.535, surrender −0.500 bets per hand.
- Card counting (Hi-Lo) is legal when done mentally; devices are not; casinos may refuse service. It does not work in RNG online blackjack.
